propositions: Structured-output validation and recovery must consolidate into a single Pydantic Agent operation with unified request budget and complete retry-contract test coverage including tool turns, output retries, and exhaustion scenarios.
Retry context must preserve complete failed responses on proven fit; otherwise omit response whole rather than truncating authoritative input, accepted output, or stored history.

Rebar deterministic extraction, fallback eligibility, terminal refusal/filter behavior, typed exhaustion, final-failure artifacts, and model provenance must remain unchanged and verified against regression matrices.
Successful operations report complete Pydantic run usage exactly once; fallback and downgrade candidates remain trace or journal events without competing usage counters.
Bespoke structured-output retry loop is removed only after compatibility suite and authorized Anthropic/Bedrock cache canaries pass, with source census and live evidence recorded.
